address: MOL Campus, Dombóvári Utca 28, Budapest, 1117, Hungary
bio: Located on the 28th floor of the tallest building in Budapest, the MOL Campus, VIRTU affords stunning views out over this historic city and the River Danube. Start with cocktails in the smart bar, then head through to the spacious, two-roomed restaurant. The menu offers something for everyone, with a pleasing mix of modern and classical dishes. If it’s available, the catfish with river prawns is delicious, as is the mangalitsa chop with fresh pickles. A fine selection of wines and professional service from a caring team complete the picture....
